children: plans to launch an up to $1B senior notes offering.

The aggregate principal amount of senior notes will be offered in two separate tranches, one representing $500M in aggregate principal amount due 2029 and the other representing $500M in aggregate principal amount due 2031.
Net proceeds are intended to be used for general corporate purposes, including the acquisition of homesites from the combined Dream Finders Homes
and repaying borrowings outstanding under the revolving credit facility.
If the Dream Finders transaction does not consummate on or before May 13, a portion of the proceeds will be used to effect a special mandatory redemption of $500M of the 2031 notes.

title: Millrose Properties plans to launch up to $1B senior notes offering
